description: This file implements DNS resolution and hostname validation logic for network security, including hostname allowlisting, private IP blocking, and creating pinned DNS lookups and dispatchers for secure network requests.

classes.name: SsrFBlockedError
classes.description: Custom error class for blocked hostname/IP address violations.

methods.name: normalizeHostnameSet
methods.description: Normalizes an array of hostnames into a set after applying hostname normalization.

methods.name: normalizeHostnameAllowlist
methods.description: Normalizes and filters hostname allowlist patterns.

methods.name: isPrivateNetworkAllowedByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if private network access is allowed by the given policy.

methods.name: shouldSkipPrivateNetworkChecks
methods.description: Determines if private network checks can be skipped based on hostname and policy.

methods.name: resolveIpv4SpecialUseBlockOptions
methods.description: Resolves IPv4 special use block options based on policy.

methods.name: isHostnameAllowedByPattern
methods.description: Checks if a hostname matches a pattern, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: matchesHostnameAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if hostname matches any pattern in the allowlist.

methods.name: looksLikeUnsupportedIpv4Literal
methods.description: Detects IPv4 literals that are unsupported or malformed.

methods.name: isPrivateIpAddress
methods.description: Determines if an IP address is private or special-use based on policy.

methods.name: isBlockedHostname
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is blocked based on internal rules.

methods.name: isBlockedHostnameOrIp
methods.description: Checks if hostname or IP address is blocked or private.

methods.name: assertAllowedHostOrIpOrThrow
methods.description: Throws error if hostname/IP is blocked.

methods.name: assertAllowedResolvedAddressesOrThrow
methods.description: Throws error if any resolved address is blocked.

methods.name: createPinnedLookup
methods.description: Creates a DNS lookup function with pinned addresses.

methods.name: resolvePinnedHostnameWithPolicy
methods.description: Resolves hostname to addresses with policy enforcement.

methods.name: resolvePinnedHostname
methods.description: Resolves hostname to addresses with default DNS lookup.

methods.name: withPinnedLookup
methods.description: Wraps connection options with a pinned DNS lookup.

methods.name: resolvePinnedDispatcherLookup
methods.description: Creates a DNS lookup for a pinned hostname override.

methods.name: createPinnedDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a network dispatcher with pinned hostname and policy.

methods.name: closeDispatcher
methods.description: Closes a network dispatcher safely.

methods.name: assertPublicHostname
methods.description: Ensures hostname resolves to a public address, throwing if blocked.
